div.div:
Why these three, and why internal
render() was 324 lines holding seven phases behind comment banners, with
eleven parameters and five try/catch blocks. StripBuilder and SliceWriter
each own the state their phase carries — the strip and its uid->Y map, the
loaded overlays and the cache — instead of it living as locals in one frame.
Their headers live under src/ and are never installed, so no consumer gets a
declaration: the public surface is still the three static entry points above.
